entries.title: Accurate search + hybrid hand-off to the real table + dictation + Loren's face on the orb
bullets: Fixed a location false-positive (an Aventura search was pulling a Puerto Rico listing whose address contained 'Aventura'); location now matches city/state only.

Every result now has follow-up actions — the main one is Open all N in the search table, which hands off to your existing full /search results grid, pre-filtered (the hybrid: Loren orchestrates, your real UI renders).
Counts are honest — 'how many for sale' returns the true total (~17,800), and the preview shows 'showing X of N'.
Voice dictation now works on the mic button, and Loren's portrait now radiates from the orb in the working session, as in the original identity.
